findings.remediation: Reject external resource URIs before render/delivery, use a strict LoadingManager policy and exact local renderer-origin request allowlist, and add restrictive CSP to delivered viewers.

validation.summary: Read all renderer callers and delivery template; independently confirmed bundled loadBuffer/loadImageSource resolve model-controlled URIs and fetch. No runtime reproduction; generated self-contained model is counterevidence to default-flow exploitation.
